description_en: Adds whitelist IP addresses for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 添加针对DDoS高防实例的白名单IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo add-auto-cc-whitelist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --whitelist src_:_192.XX.XX.1_,_src_:_192.XX.XX.2 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddAutoCcWhitelist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance for which you want to add whitelist IP addresses.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
要添加白名单IP的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the whitelist IP addresses to add. This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a whitelist IP struct that contains the following field:

src: String | Required | The IP address to add to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
要添加的白名单IP的配置。使用JSON数组转化的字符串表示。JSON数组的每个元素是一个白名单IP结构体，具体包含以下参数：

src：String类型 | 必选 | 要添加到白名单的IP地址
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en:
[Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated.

This parameter specifies the validity period of blacklist IP addresses. Whitelist IP addresses are permanently valid by default. You do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
该参数已废弃。

该参数表示黑名单IP的有效期。白名单IP默认永久有效，无需设置该参数
parameters.name: expire_time
